newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee closes up in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee closes up in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: KARACHI, Pakistan, Feb 16 - The Pakistani rupee ended 0.17 rupees up at 40.90 to the dollar on Sunday as investors unloaded the U.S. currency after the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index surged 4.39 percent, dealers said.
"People are moving into the stock market which offers quicker and higher returns now," a dealer said. "The Pakistani rupee is likely to remain firm against the dollar."
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.20 percent, down from its previous close at 3.2 percent.
